purpose: Rally joiner reference used by BearLab for every simulated non-user participant.

slots.effect: Increasing damage dealt by all troops by 25%
slots.why: The leftmost hero's first expedition skill is the only joiner skill consistently reported as eligible.
Fixed for reproducibility; no independent evidence that a joiner's second slot changes Bear damage.
Fixed for reproducibility; no independent evidence that a joiner's third slot changes Bear damage.

selection_policy.candidate_pool: One first expedition skill per joiner
selection_policy.tie_breaking: Reported as join order when skill level is tied; model records this as very probable rather than confirmed.
selection_policy.duplicate_policy: Do not assume duplicate skills stack or do not stack without an ingame test; show the issue in the audit.
